apply.branch.atBrace: The branch name must not contain "@{".
apply.branch.chars: Use letters, digits and . _ - / only, starting with a letter or digit, without "//", "/." or a trailing "/" or ".".
apply.branch.dash: The branch name must not start with "-".
apply.branch.dots: The branch name must not contain "..".
apply.branch.lock: A part of the branch name must not end in ".lock".
apply.branch.reserved: That branch name is reserved. Pick a name such as kiln/update-listing.
apply.branch.spaces: The branch name must not start or end with a space.
apply.branch.tooLong: The branch name is longer than 200 characters.
apply.done.already: This change set was already applied.
apply.done.local: Committed to {{branch}} in the local clone.
apply.done.prFailed: Committed and pushed {{branch}}, but the pull request was not opened. You can retry it.
apply.done.pushFailed: Committed to {{branch}}, but the push failed. The commit is kept; you can retry the push.
apply.done.pushedAndPr: Committed, pushed and opened a pull request.
apply.githubPr.noConnection: This repository has no GitHub connection, so there is no pull request to open. Commit to a branch of the local clone instead.
apply.local.noClone: No local clone is attached to this repository. Attach a folder in the Local clone card first.
apply.local.notEnabled: Writing to local clones is not enabled. Set {{env}}=true on the server and restart it.
apply.local.settingUnknown: Could not read the server setting for writing to local clones. Reload the page and try again.
apply.localExplanation: This writes one commit to a new branch of the local clone on the server. Your checked out branch, the working folder and the index are not touched, so nothing you have open changes. Hooks do not run. Look at it later with git switch.
apply.localOnly.base: This repository is only a folder on the server, so there is no pull request to open. Applying an approved change set commits the files to a new branch of the folder; you merge that branch yourself.
apply.localOnly.off: {{base}} Writing to local clones is not enabled: set {{env}}=true on the server and restart it.
apply.localOnly.titleOff: Local-only: committing to a branch is off
apply.localOnly.titleOn: Local-only: changes are committed to a new branch
apply.pr.needsPush: A pull request needs the branch on GitHub. Tick "Push the branch to GitHub" first.
apply.push.noConnection: This repository has no GitHub connection, so there is nowhere to push the branch.
apply.retry.pushPr: Push and open a pull request
apply.retry.pushPrRetry: Retry the push and open a pull request
apply.signature.label: Signed ({{format}})
apply.signature.tipGpg: GitHub shows "Verified" on this commit only if the public GPG key is added to your GitHub account, and the commit's email is a verified email of that account. The signature is not checked here.
apply.signature.tipSsh: GitHub shows "Verified" on this commit only if the public SSH key (as a signing key, not only an authentication key) is added to your GitHub account, and the commit's email is a verified email of that account. The signature is not checked here.
apply.signing.notSigned: Commits are not signed (set {{env}} to enable).
apply.step.behind: The latest fix up is not on GitHub yet
apply.step.prWaiting: Pull request waiting for the push
fixup.behind: The commit is in the local clone only. Push the branch to put it on GitHub.
fixup.choice.branchMineDesc: Overwrites the branch's text with yours, in the new commit.
fixup.choice.branchTheirsDesc: Leaves the branch's text as it is and adds nothing for this file.
fixup.choice.repoMineDesc: Overwrites what the repository has with your text.
fixup.choice.repoTheirsDesc: Drops your change; the branch gets the repository's text.
fixup.diff.same: The store text is the same as when the pull was made.
fixup.done.addedPr: Added commit {{sha}} to {{branch}}. The pull request is open.
fixup.done.upToDate: The branch {{branch}} is up to date.
fixup.done.upToDatePr: The branch {{branch}} is up to date. The pull request is open.
fixup.dropped.identical: The repository has the store text already.
fixup.dropped.missingInStore: The store has no value for it any more.
fixup.dropped.other: It cannot be pulled right now.
fixup.dropped.overLimit: The store text is over its limit, so it was not pulled.
fixup.dropped.repoAhead: The repository changed after it matched the store, so pulling would undo that.
fixup.preview.files_one: {{count}} file would be in the new commit.
fixup.preview.files_other: {{count}} files would be in the new commit.
fixup.preview.noFiles: No file changes, but a step is left to finish.
fixup.preview.nothing: Nothing to fix up: the branch already has everything.
fixup.promise: This adds one commit to the branch {{branch}}. It does not rewrite history, and nothing is forced.
fixup.recompute.doneDraft: Recomputed from the live store. {{summary}} It is a draft again and needs approval.
fixup.recompute.nothingLeft: Nothing left to pull: the repository has everything the store has. Discard the change set.
fixup.recompute.unchanged: The store and the repository are as they were: the change set is unchanged.
fixup.stage.branch: The branch has another change to this file in the same place.
fixup.stage.repository: The repository changed this file in the same place.
fixup.state.removed: No longer part of the pull
refresh.done.draftAgain: {{message}} It is a draft again and needs approval.
refresh.done.nothingLeft: Nothing left to apply: the repository already has this change. Discard the change set.
refresh.done.unchanged: Nothing changed in the repository: the change set is as it was.
refresh.reason.addedUpstream: Your change adds this file, but the repository added it with other text.
refresh.reason.deletedUpstream: Your change edits this file, but the repository deleted it.
refresh.reason.editedUpstream: Your change deletes this file, but the repository edited it.
refresh.reason.invalidJson: The merged file would not be valid JSON.
refresh.reason.tooLarge: The two versions differ too much to merge line by line.
refresh.resolution.mineDesc: Overwrites what the repository has with your text.
refresh.resolution.theirsDesc: Drops your change to this file.
refresh.state.appliedHint: The repository already has this change. It leaves the change set.
refresh.state.changedHint: The file changed elsewhere; your change fits on top of it.
refresh.state.conflictHint: The file changed in the same place. You choose.
refresh.state.sameHint: The repository has not changed this file.
refresh.summary.upToDate: Up to date: the repository has not changed these files.
staged.availability.off: Writing drafts to a store is switched off on this server. Someone who runs it sets {{env}}=true and restarts it (see docs/api/staged-changes.md). Staging works meanwhile; nothing here can reach a store until then.
staged.availability.unknown: Could not find out whether pushing drafts is switched on. Reload the page to try again.
staged.blocked.invalid: Some staged items have an error. Fix or remove them first.
staged.blocked.notLoaded: The staged changes are not loaded yet.
staged.error.fieldNotPushable: {{message}} Fields a draft push can write: {{fields}}.
staged.error.noSourceValue: {{message}} Read the repository again, then stage it.
staged.error.notFound: That no longer exists. Reload the page.
staged.error.rateLimited: The repository is being read too often. Try again in {{wait}}.
staged.fail.blocked: The store says something staged cannot be written as it is. Nothing was written. Fix it in the stepper or remove it, then preview again.
staged.fail.changesInReview: The store has changes in review for this app. Wait until they are decided, then try again. This tool never cancels a review.
staged.fail.connectionBroke: The connection broke while the push was running, so it is not known whether the server received it. Do not push again yet: preview again (that only reads the store), then check the draft in the store console.
staged.fail.disabled: Writing drafts to a store is switched off on this server ({{env}}). Nothing was written. Someone who runs the server sets {{env}}=true and restarts it.
staged.fail.draftNotAllowed: {{message}} Nothing was committed. This tool never retries without holding the changes back, because that could send them for review.
staged.fail.noEditableVersion: {{message}} Create the next version in App Store Connect, then preview again.
staged.fail.nothingStaged: Nothing is staged for this app.
staged.fail.outcomeUnknown: {{message}} Do not push again yet: preview again (that only reads the store), then check the draft in the store console.
staged.fail.rateLimitedMinute: The store is limiting requests. Try again in a minute. This app never retries by itself.
staged.fail.rateLimitedSeconds_one: The store is limiting requests. Try again in {{count}} second. This app never retries by itself.
staged.fail.rateLimitedSeconds_other: The store is limiting requests. Try again in {{count}} seconds. This app never retries by itself.
staged.fail.request: The request failed. Check your connection and read the staged changes again.
staged.fail.restageUnreadable: {{message}} Stage the set again from the Assets tab.
staged.fail.stateChanged: The staged changes or the store’s draft changed since you previewed this, so nothing was written. Read the new preview and confirm again.
staged.fail.storeUnavailable: {{message}} The store could not be reached; nothing was changed.
staged.fail.timeout: A read of the store did not answer in time. If you are not sure whether anything was written, preview again: that reads the draft.
staged.fail.writeInProgress: {{message}} Nothing was written by this request. Wait a moment, then confirm again.
staged.field.noRepoValue: The repository has no value for this field.
staged.field.notStoreLocale: This is not a store locale code, so it cannot be staged.
staged.notPushable.apple: A draft push cannot write this field: the App Store keeps the name, subtitle and privacy policy URL on the app information, not on the version.
staged.notPushable.generic: A draft push cannot write this field.
staged.notSubmitted: Nothing is submitted for review or published by a push. Submitting is a separate step with its own switch and confirmation.
staged.preview.setCreated: A new set is created in the draft: {{parts}}.
staged.preview.setCreatedPlain: A new set is created in the draft.
staged.preview.setSame: Already the same in the draft.
staged.pushRoleReason: Pushing a draft to a store needs the admin or owner role.
staged.reverseImageSyncNote: The store's images cannot be staged directly. "Pull from store" puts them into the repository as a draft change set to review and apply; after that they can be staged from there. Files you upload here are staged as they are.
staged.set.iconNotStore: {{name}} is the icon of the project, not a store file.
staged.set.noCommit: The repository read named no commit, so the files cannot be pinned. Read the repository again.
staged.set.noLocale: Files in the project folder or a flat folder have no store locale, so they cannot be staged.
staged.set.notImage: {{name}} is not a PNG or JPEG: only those are uploaded.
staged.set.notRead: {{name}} was not read (too large, over the read budget or unreadable), so it cannot be staged.
staged.set.tooLarge: {{name}} is larger than the {{mb}} MB this server uploads.
staged.set.tooMany_one: The store takes at most {{count}} file in this set and the repository has {{have}}. Remove the extra files from the repository first.
staged.set.tooMany_other: The store takes at most {{count}} files in this set and the repository has {{have}}. Remove the extra files from the repository first.
staged.stageRoleReason: Your role cannot stage changes. A member, admin or owner can.
staged.submitNextStep: After a push, "Submit for review…" (admin and up, when the server allows it) hands the draft to the store's review. Releasing is a separate step with its own switch and confirmation.
staged.summary.fieldsSame_one: {{count}} release field is already the same
staged.summary.fieldsSame_other: {{count}} release fields are already the same
staged.summary.nothingToDo: Nothing to do: the store’s draft already holds everything that is staged.
staged.summary.remove_one: {{count}} file will be removed from the draft
staged.summary.remove_other: {{count}} files will be removed from the draft
staged.summary.setsSame_one: {{count}} graphic set is already the same
staged.summary.setsSame_other: {{count}} graphic sets are already the same
staged.version.playEdit: A Google Play edit, committed as changes not sent for review
tray.loadFailed: Could not load the staged changes
tray.pushOff: Nothing staged. Pushing drafts is switched off
tray.pushRole: Nothing staged. Pushing needs the admin or owner role
tray.pushUnknown: Nothing staged. Could not check whether pushing drafts is on
